# Quick reference: order coordinator

## Every day

1. Open the exceptions list at the start of the day. [SC-10 step 1]
2. Settle each line: correct the code or note it for the customer. [SC-10 step 2]
3. Check that new orders reached the order sheet. [SC-01]
4. Ask a customer for a PDF when an email could not be read. [SC-02]
5. Keep product codes in the LC-nnnn form. [SC-05]

## When something looks wrong

An order missing from the sheet is on the exceptions list; if it is not, ask the operations manager. [map/future.md item 2]

Came up in testing: UAT-01.
